item.title: Selva Pascuala Mural
item.description: Overview The Selva Pascuala mural is a rock painting in Villar del Humo, Spain that contains one of the earliest possible depictions of magic mushrooms in Europe.

item.title: Minoan "poppy goddess" figurines
item.description: Overview The Minoan “poppy goddess” figurines are terracotta sculptures from Greece that depict a goddess crowned with opium poppy seed capsules.

item.title: Hymn to Ninkasi
item.description: Overview The Hymn to Ninkasi is a prayer song that was sung by Sumerian farmers to the goddess of beer Ninkasi, and it is also considered the oldest beer recipe in the world for which evidence currently exists.

item.title: Cylinder Seal of Queen Puabi
item.description: Overview The Cylinder Seal of Queen Puabi is an lapis lazuli seal that was found in the Royal Cemetery at Ur in the queen’s tomb with her body in 1928.

item.title: Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapies (RMAT)
item.description: Overview Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapies (RMAT) are medical treatments that replace or repair damage in the human body that is the underlying cause of disease or injury.

item.title: Neuroinflammation
item.description: Overview Neuroinflammation refers to a type of inflammation that occurs in the central nervous system, including the brain and spine, in response to injury or infections.
